about: The burner heats the boiler to the setpoint on three steps: Start at 2 s, the flame 20 s after the first dose, the water from 40 °C at 150 s climbing to 60.5 °C at 400 s with the setpoint at 60 - the 6 kW step far from it, the 5 kW one from 8 °C under it (about 300 s), the 3 kW one from 3 °C under it (about 357 s), and at the setpoint the fire smoulders (the scenario's `auto_smoulder_s`).
